## Tuning log (hand-recorded from scratch runs; k=5, dev slice unless stated)

Plain char-3gram TF-IDF top-k does not scale: against the full test India S1 (810k), a name query
touches 288k posting entries on average and a name+address query 4.0M, i.e. 4.8 ms and 27 ms per
record even with 15 threads (hours per country). sparse_dot_topn is memory-bandwidth bound here:
15 threads give only ~2x over 1 thread, and process-level parallelism is no better.

| TF-IDF variant | dev pair recall | dev F0.5 ceiling | India recall | full-scale top-k cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| unpruned | 0.9784 | 0.9921 | 0.9501 | 4.8 + 27 ms/record (days) |
| global max_df 0.02 / 0.01 | 0.9506 | 0.9793 | 0.8942 | ~1.7 ms/record (~4.7 h) |
| global max_df 0.005 / 0.002 | 0.8612 | 0.9314 | 0.7846 | fast |
| prefix filter 3 / 6 | 0.9407 | 0.9786 | 0.9046 | ~0.35 ms/record |
| **prefix filter 4 / 8 (chosen)** | **0.9605** | **0.9858** | **0.9281** | ~0.6 ms/record |
| prefix filter 6 / 12 | 0.9742 | 0.9907 | 0.9449 | ~1.4 ms/record |

Prefix filter = probe the index with only the record's N rarest trigrams (name / name+address),
keep 3k best S1 by that partial score, re-score them with the true full-vector cosine.

## Chosen configuration

`CONFIG` in src/blocking.py: k_name = k_nameaddr = 5, prefix 4 / 8, probe_mult 3, min_cos 0.3,
block_cap 50, char_wb 3-grams hashed to 2^20, chunk 200k records.

## Full-scale flags

- **Runtime over the 45-minute budget:** test ~122 min, full train (all 2.2M S1, which serves both
  the LightGBM train split and validation at real density) ~229 min. 70-75% of the per-record time
  is the name+address top-k.
- **Memory fits:** calibration peaked at ~5.0 GB with all records loaded and the full S1 index built.
  Record texts are built per chunk, so the full run should stay near 5-6 GB.
- **Pair volume is the next wall:** ~82M pairs for test and ~83M for train (8.2 per record; dev
  shows only 4.6 because it is less dense). 82M x 27 float32 features = 8.9 GB, so featurizing and
  scoring must stream chunk by chunk, and at RA's 1M pairs/min target featurizing alone takes ~80 min.
